facts.fact: ISO's member register records INIQ, the National Institute of Quality Infrastructure, as Angola's body for the Angolan Quality System, a public-law institute under its Organic Statute approved by Presidential Decree 95/21 of April 2021, offering elaboration and sale of technical standards and holding correspondent membership of ISO.
